Local-first CLI for reviewing Git changes, security boundaries, and blast radius before merge.

Usage: repopilot <COMMAND>

Commands:
  cache     Manage RepoPilot's local scan cache
  baseline  Manage accepted baseline findings
  review    Review findings that touch changed Git diff lines
  scan      Scan a project, folder, or file for findings
  snapshot  Mark the repository state before an agent or manual change
  ai        Generate a local AI-ready handoff (context, plan, and guidance)
  init      Generate a default repopilot.toml configuration file
  mcp       Run a local Model Context Protocol server over stdio
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help (see more with '--help')
  -V, --version  Print version

COMMON WORKFLOWS:
  repopilot review .                          # review working-tree changes
  repopilot review . --base origin/main       # review a branch before merge
  repopilot review . --detail full            # show evidence and verification
  repopilot snapshot                          # mark state before an agent change
  repopilot review . --since-snapshot         # review the complete agent change
  repopilot scan .                            # run a repository-wide audit
  repopilot baseline create .                 # accept current findings as debt
  repopilot scan . --baseline .repopilot/baseline.json --fail-on new-high
  repopilot ai context . --focus security     # generate AI-ready context
  repopilot mcp --root .                      # expose read-only tools to an agent
